### 1. User expression and simulator behaviour
Marisol Delgado wants "the hold on that RAV4 extended once, enough to carry you into next week"; deal KTD-26-11432; does not suggest rules; agrees if something must be done first; pays "exactly that amount yourself with your debit card" when handed the payment; declines a second extension. Phone 9375551236 and license last4 1418 match `find_customers` (customer_type individual).

### 2. Act / wait / refuse
Act, after a prerequisite. KTD-26-11432: `'New Vehicle Retail Purchase'`, `status 'reserved'`, `reserved_date '2026-10-20'`, `hold_expires_date '2026-10-25'`, `hold_extension_count 0` (schedule: most extensions 2), `cash_price 41265.0`, `deposit_held_balance 1000.0` (one credit_card deposit 2026-10-20). Request on 2026-10-21 = day after the reservation date -> hold_extension_deposit 1.1 applies ("The buyer adds the extension deposit") and hold_extension_length governs reach. Blocking sentence (hold_extension_length): "The extension days are not worked out until a deposit received on the handling date stands on the deal." No 2026-10-21 deposit on the deal -> wait on it.

### 3. Objects
Single deal e88c4d7b (KTD-26-11432). Service account SA-148730 `Kessler Owner Rewards Gold`, `active`, opened 2018-05-14. Ledger: customer-pay RO lines 2025-09-14, 2025-12-09, 2026-04-16, 2026-08-11 (line A labor+parts); `service_payment_returned` check 531.56 on 2025-12-18.

### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Extension deposit (extension_deposit_calculation + factors):
- Rate: Owner Rewards (extension_deposit_owner_rewards_rate) Gold active -> 4% (replaces 5%); hold-timing add-on: 2026-10-21 -> 2026-10-25 = 4 days -> +0.5%; returned-payment add-on: one returned check (2025-12-18, 10 whole months) -> +1%. Rate 5.5%.
- Required 0.055 x 41265.00 = 2269.575.
- Shares: deposit-received (1000/41265 = 2.42%, 2–5%) -> 0.95; service spend: customer-pay labor+parts with fewer than 12 whole months to 2026-10-21: 517.06 (2025-12-09) + 136.32 (2026-04-16) + 378.03 (2026-08-11) = 1031.41 (2025-09-14 is 13 months, out) -> 0.90. 2269.575 x 0.95 x 0.90 = 1940.4866.
- Credited (extension_deposit_crediting_of_held_deposits): a credit-card deposit still held -> deposit held 1000 less card 1000 = 0.00.
- To collect 1940.4866 >= 250 -> rounded **1940.49**, debit card, deal e88c4d7b. Acceptance: total 2940.49 <= 10000; debit card listed.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): 5% x 41265 = 2063.25; credit min(1000, 1237.95) = 1000 -> 1063.25. Different.
(b) Extension days (extension_days_calculation + factors), after the deposit stands:
- Base extension days 3 (New Vehicle Retail Purchase). Added days: tenure (hold_extension_service_tenure_days) 2018-05-14 -> 2026-10-21 = 101 whole months -> +1; service visits (hold_extension_service_visit_days): customer-pay line A ROs in 12 months = 3 (2025-12-09, 2026-04-16, 2026-08-11) -> +1; deposit cover (hold_extension_deposit_cover_days): deposit held 2940.49 = 7.13% of price (5–7.5%), collected funds (debit card 1940.49) held -> +1. Extension length 6.
- Starting day (hold_extension_starting_day): expiry 2026-10-25 is a Sunday -> Monday 2026-10-26. New expiry 2026-10-26 + 6 = 2026-11-01. Extension days passed (from 2026-10-25) = **7**.
- Fall-back: 3 (new expiry 2026-10-28). Different. Without the deposit standing, deposit cover would be none (1000 = 2.4%, no collected funds) -> 6 instead of 7.

### 5. Tool sequence
verify -> finders -> unlock_user `pay_extension_deposit_9124466d`, hand over (e88c4d7b, 1940.49) -> customer pays by debit card -> unlock+call `extend_vehicle_hold_21e7c68f`(e88c4d7b, 7) -> tell new last day 2026-11-01. Terminal: deposit held 2940.49, hold expiry 2026-11-01, extension count 1.

Hop P0->P1 **state-derived**: hold_extension_length "not worked out until a deposit received on the handling date stands on the deal"; deal shows only the 2026-10-20 deposit; "deposit ... on a day after the reservation date" reaches hold_extension_deposit 1.3 ("is the extension deposit. It is taken at the amount set under these terms") with the customer's own payment tool.

- Order P1 -> P0. No hop pre-solved.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Extend only": excluded by the waiting sentence and the deal's deposit rows; it would also give 6 not 7 days.
- Credit-card payment for the deposit: the handed tool is debit card; the customer refuses credit card; also card deposits are not collected funds.
- Counting from the request date: excluded ("never from the request date").
- Starting from the Sunday expiry: excluded by the weekend rule judged first.
- Same-day (reservation-date) branch: excluded, reservation 2026-10-20, request 2026-10-21.
- Open reading noted: extension_deposit_calculation says the credit ceiling is "60 percent of the extension deposit required, which is the rate times the cash price" — whether the ceiling is taken before or after shares is not pinned; immaterial here (credited 0.00).
